sections.title: Life cycle and habitat
sections.text: An annual herb of the Mediterranean region, growing in cultivated ground, fallows and dry or disturbed sites. Height varies among floras, from a few centimetres to several tens.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: The basal rosette has divided leaves and yellow flower heads. The curved achenes are about 5–7.5 mm long; their pappus differs between outer and inner florets.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use is documented in the sources consulted.
